description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join the founding engineering team at an early-stage AI company developing a foundational model from scratch with a novel architecture, rather than fine-tuning existing models. This hands-on role contributes to core model development as well as practical, production-ready LLM systems.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and improve foundational models across training, reinforcement learning, and model architecture.

 - Develop and ship production LLM applications, including agents, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, or model-serving systems.

 - Create evaluations, benchmarks, and quality monitoring for LLM systems.

 - Contribute as a hands-on individual engineer across model development and application work.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - One to five years of professional engineering experience.

 - Practical experience building foundational models across the model-building pipeline, including training, reinforcement learning, and architecture.

 - A track record of building and shipping production LLM applications.

 - Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with an ML framework such as PyTorch.

 - Experience evaluating LLM systems through evaluations, benchmarks, or quality monitoring.

 - Interest in a ground-level individual contributor role.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: $180,000 to $220,000 USD annually.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California. Candidates should be based in the San Francisco Bay Area or willing to work on-site in San Francisco.
